interpretation: A release for layer L below the final layer is synchronized before the next layer's CPU pool call. event_pending records cudaEventQuery immediately before cudaEventSynchronize; sync_wall_us is host time inside cudaEventSynchronize. Token-tail releases are excluded from the pre-pool count.
limitations: Trace and event-query instrumentation add overhead; decode throughput from this run is not a normal-use performance result.

sync_wall_us measures host time inside cudaEventSynchronize. All pre-pool events were pending before sync, so these calls waited for GPU completion; this does not quantify the decode speedup an overlap change could achieve.
Expert pool dispatch wall time includes Ring release synchronization, source preparation, activation quantization, and pool work; it is not CPU expert compute time alone.

measurement.instrumentation: STRATA_RING_ACCESS_TRACE plus STRATA_RING_TRACE; each Ring release event queries readiness immediately before cudaEventSynchronize
